supportedSharpExclusionAssessment.use: first raster operation lazy-requires sharp; used by metadata, normalization and model request-image conversion
supportedSharpExclusionAssessment.reason: Excluding the active platform binary without a separately qualified compatible replacement leaves sharp unable to perform the required raster operations.

electronAlternativeAssessment.reason: The official patent-reduced FFmpeg build changes codec flags, not FFmpeg to a permissive license; cannot relabel it or silently remove media support.

officeAssessment.reason: Preserving the native/full Office capability retains the actual engine license; a DSH MIT wrapper does not relicense it.
